title: 🔆🔅Istanbul, November 2nd - Iran’s Minister of Economy Seyyed Ali Madanizadeh made remarks on the sidelines of the 42nd Ministerial Session of the Standing Committee for Economic and Commercial Cooperation (COMCEC) of the Organization of Islamic Cooperation (OIC).
text:
🔆🔅Istanbul, November 2nd - Iran’s Minister of Economy Seyyed Ali Madanizadeh made remarks on the sidelines of the 42nd Ministerial Session of the Standing Committee for Economic and Commercial Cooperation (COMCEC) of the Organization of Islamic Cooperation (OIC)."

"--------"

"SOT1, Ali Madanizadeh, Minister of Economic Affairs and Finance of Iran (Farsi)-(00:00 - 00:23): “Serious topics that will be discussed and examined by the countries in this session include the discussion of economic conditions resulting from the events of recent months in the region. Well, many countries have experienced severe inflation and recession, and have seen sharp increases in prices, especially the sharp increase in the prices of energy""

"SOT2, Ali Madanizadeh, Minister of Economic Affairs and Finance of Iran (Farsi)-(00:24 - 00:52): “We will also have bilateral meetings with the trade or economy ministers of some countries, which is part of a series of meetings following my travels in recent weeks to expand relations and to prevent US sanctions and pressures from being effective, so that, hopefully, we can thwart their Operation Economic Outcast plan.
